From the test kitchen

All techniques
01Salt your pasta water properly

About a tablespoon for every four liters. It should taste like a well-seasoned soup, not the sea.

02Toast grains before simmering

A few minutes in fat gives rice, orzo and couscous a deeper, nuttier flavor and keeps the grains distinct.

03Zest before you juice

It is almost impossible the other way round. Zest goes in last, off the heat, where its perfume survives.
